description: Creator vetting for one Instagram, TikTok or YouTube profile: fake-follower risk, engagement quality, consistency, red flags and a fair sponsored-post rate. Use before paying or partnering with an influencer, to judge whether the audience is real and what a fair rate is. Fetches the profile itself unless you pass stats. Returns score, fakeFollowerRisk, engagementQuality, consistency (all 0-100), estimatedRateUsd {min, max}, redFlags[], summary and the metrics behind them. For raw profile numbers without a verdict use social_instagram/social_tiktok/social_youtube (cheaper). Price: $0.20 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

profile.description: Optional profile stats you already have; skips the fetch

name: creator_vetting

estimatedRateUsd.description: Estimated fair rate range per sponsored post

fakeFollowerRisk.description: 0-100, higher means more likely bought or inactive audience

metrics.description: The numbers every score is built from

benchmarkEngagementRate.description: Expected rate for this platform and tier

likesCv.description: Spread of likes across posts (stdev / mean)

spikeCount.description: Posts with likes over 3x the median

tier.description: nano, micro, mid, macro or mega

redFlags.description: Short reasons to be careful, empty when none

title: Creator vetting
